ideas.pitch: An agentic multi-agent system that monitors multi-source campus feeds, forecasts infrastructure risks, and autonomously orchestrates emergency response protocols.
ideas.title: Autonomous Campus Incident and Safety Intelligence Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines predictive forecasting models proven in winning AI governance hacks with real-time autonomous multi-agent execution, scoring high on technical implementation and practical campus impact.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized AI agent marketplace that autonomously negotiates, dispatches, and settles micro-tasks and computing jobs among student researchers using secure escrow.
ideas.title: Agentic Autonomous Marketplace for Academic & Research Compute
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements the autonomous agent marketplace architecture that won the Synthesis Hackathon, providing judges with a polished, end-to-end working economic loop.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that inspects campus and regional satellite imagery to track environmental changes, resource utilization, and regulatory land compliance.
ideas.title: AI-Powered Institutional Compliance and Satellite Monitoring Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical execution of the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up by integrating computer vision and spatial data processing into an actionable monitoring product.

ideas.pitch: An agentic video intelligence tool that ingests unstructured lecture recordings, transcribes and indexes semantic concepts, and provides instant deep-searchable knowledge retrieval.
ideas.title: Multimodal Video Intelligence Platform for Lecture & Archive Search
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of the Data & Design Hackathon by converting messy unstructured data into an immediately useful productivity tool for educational institutions.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent platform tailored for college students that aggregates mess hall menus and local food options to deliver real-time personalized nutrition tracking and wellness coaching.
ideas.title: Agentic Personalized Campus Wellness and Nutrition Architect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-engagement concept of the Hour Hackathon winner, focusing on immediate usability, high aesthetic polish, and direct relevance to student life.
